baseline.what: fresh-start control: scrambled Sobol start (64), no pool and no migration, the same decoder, objective and promotion; never merged and not eligible to win

rerun.rerun_platform: native static x86_64 on Linux; the island of record ran in a linux/amd64 container under Rosetta on xbabe4

cohort.what: warm-started islands in asynchronous rounds per host; at the end of a host's round the hub merges its islands into the latest pool, from which the host's next round starts

grid_check.rule: the winner is the highest-ranked design whose h 0.2 mass agrees with h 0.15; others are reported, never ranked

mass.of_record: partial-volume integral of the decoded AM field at h 0.2 mm

plate_mesh_check.rule: in rank order, the first design passing the grid check whose every load case meets its requirement on every plate mesh; a case's margin of record is its minimum over the meshes

g5-continue.role: every island, merge and re-evaluation of the search

provenance.platform_of_record: linux/amd64: static x86_64 binaries, native on Linux and in a Rosetta container on macOS; Tier 2 at h 0.2 mm

ranking.how: every elite of the final pool re-evaluated at Tier 1, h 0.4; the top 64 at Tier 2, h 0.2

v5_winner_same_platform.what: the v5.0.0 winner's committed genome at Tier 2, h 0.2 and on the plate check meshes, on the v6 platform of record

status: computational design; not built, printed or physically tested

warm_start.what: the 1,508 final elites of the v5.0.0 cohort (islands 01-16; the random-search control excluded), re-evaluated at Tier 1, h 0.4 on this platform and merged to the best record per niche
